name: Mirage Flats
summary: East of Dustbelch Grotto, heat shimmers over Mirage Flats in the Badlands. Hungry predators roam the dry plateau beneath the desert sun.

sections.title: A Scorched Wasteland
sections.body: East of Dustbelch Grotto, cracked red dirt runs beneath wavering heat. Few civilized souls linger on Mirage Flats. Giant buzzards circle overhead, watching for scraps left by ferocious ridge stalkers and crag coyotes that hunt in packs through the brush.

faq.q: Where are the Mirage Flats located?
faq.answer: Mirage Flats lie in the central Badlands, east of Dustbelch Grotto. Travelers crossing between the western cliffs and eastern canyons pass over this sun-baked ground.

faq.q: Why is the area called Mirage Flats?
faq.answer: Mirage Flats takes its name from the heat shimmering above its flat, stony earth. The wavering sights can disorient travelers crossing the wastes.
Rabid crag coyotes hunt in packs, while ridge stalker patriarchs prowl the scrub. Giant buzzards circle overhead, waiting to feed on whatever falls in the dust.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can track, study, or tame the aggressive beasts roaming these open plains. They include fierce ridge stalkers and coyotes hardened by desert survival.
